run_migrate_checkpoint_cli: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI to convert an OCP checkpoint to fm_release format with --checkpoint-in and --checkpoint-out
run_migrate_checkpoint_add_stress: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with --add-stress to automatically add stress tasks for datasets missing them
run_migrate_checkpoint_model_version: run the migrate_checkpoint CLI with --model-version to set a specific model version on eSCNMDMoeBackbone checkpoints
call_migrate_checkpoint_function: call migrate_checkpoint to load a checkpoint, update module imports and configs, and optionally remove static keys
call_generate_stress_task_config: call generate_stress_task_config to create a stress task configuration dict for a given dataset name and RMSD value
